summary: Independently read all proposed code citations and upstream contradiction evidence in ftboy.c, inlines.h, and ftparts.c. All three changes are supported. Pickup's unmatched hold-kind exception is explicit in functionality.md and remains part of the accepted interpretation. External identity, compiled layout, and model-application timing deferrals accepted.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical adapter forwards the incoming boolean and two zeros. Shared drop handling unconditionally invokes ftAnim_80070FB4 with selection -1 and invokes ftAnim_80070CC4 only when the incoming boolean is true.

Canonical pickup handling confirms fixed zero arguments, the heavy-item guard, hold-kind-dependent selection, and the separate catch-flag branch. The accompanying functionality document explicitly preserves the unmatched-hold-kind path: no selection call, but the catch-flag call remains possible.

Canonical helper signatures distinguish boolean item options from integer model selection arguments. ftParts_80074A4C writes the pending field and flag. PUSH_ATTRS copies into backup storage and installs its pointer; COPY_ATTRS overwrites through the existing pointer. No allocation or application-scheduling claim is introduced.

contradictions.reason: Accept supersession of the two 'both disabled' descriptions: zero arguments do not suppress all operations. Drop's selection call is unconditional; pickup preserves heavy-item and unmatched-hold-kind exceptions.
Accept supersession of the conflated slot-zero data-flow description. Item arguments are booleans, death requests integer model-group selection, and attribute installation differs from refresh.

Accept the external-character-mapping deferrals for all eight unresolved facts and all five unresolved links. Resource names and callback behavior establish internal Zako Boy integration, not independent proof of the Male Wire Frame identification. Callback existence also does not establish normal gameplay item availability.

Accept the additional death-state deferral: zero is a pending numeric selection, not independently a default visible variant. The separate application routine does not establish when application occurs.
Accept the compiled-section deferral, including the resource-block link: source declarations, address comments, and force-active pragmas do not establish binary placement or extent.
